author: Arnav
problem: sales lists a (stall, amount) pair for every sale at a farmers market, with at least one sale. Return the stall that took the most money in total.
bug_description: Uses max(totals), which compares the stall names, instead of max(totals, key=totals.get), so it returns the alphabetically last stall.

comments.accurate: Stall with the highest total takings across all its sales
comments.wrong_behavior: Totals each stall's sales and returns the top entry in the totals table
comments.wrong_location: Stall selection verified; check each sale is added to the right stall's total
